# StandardIn

Standard input, with the console-versus-redirection question answered at acquisition.

```rux
pub struct StandardIn {
    pub pendingCount: uint;
    // private fields
}
```

On Windows a console delivers UTF-16, which arrives here converted to UTF-8 so a program reads the same bytes
whether its input is typed or piped; a redirected stream is read as the bytes it is. The value carries the
few bytes of a converted character that did not fit the caller's buffer, and a surrogate half waiting for the
other, so no reading pattern can tear a character.

## Associated functions

<h3 id="acquire"><code>Acquire</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Acquire() -> StandardIn
```

The process's standard input.
Asks the platform once whether the stream is a console; nothing is opened, and nothing needs closing.

**Returns**: the stream, which the process owns for its whole life

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Io/Src/Standard.rux#L140)
